mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS workId, w.title AS workTitle, w.image_url AS workImageUrl, r.post_count AS postCount, r.id AS latestPostId, r.title AS latestPostTitle, m.nickname AS latestPostAuthor, r.created_at AS latestPostCreatedAt FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.work_id, p.member_id, p.title, p.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.work_id ORDER BY p.id DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.work_id) AS post_count FROM post p ) r JOIN work w ON w.id = r.work_id JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.work_id) FROM post p
